options_dataEraseConfirm: Erase the whole library and all conversations from this device? This cannot be undone.
options_dataIntro: Everything is stored locally. Nothing leaves without your action.
options_keyAuthError: This key was rejected. Check it in the Anthropic console.
options_keyClearConfirm: Clear the API key from this device?
options_keyHelp: Stored on this device. Used only to call api.anthropic.com.
options_keyNetworkError: api.anthropic.com is unreachable. Check your connection and try again.
options_keyPermissionRefused: Without permission to reach api.anthropic.com, the key cannot be verified.
options_keyUnknownError: The key could not be verified.
options_keyWarning: Key saved, but the API is temporarily limited or overloaded: it could not be verified.
options_onboardingReadyBody: Select a passage in a page, or open the side panel from the browser toolbar.
options_onboardingReadBody: Claude Everywhere reads nothing on its own. What you send is highlighted: it is the only thing that leaves your machine.
options_overlayAllSites: Show the floating bar on all sites
options_permissionRefused: Permission was denied: the setting stays off.
options_privacyDestination: This data is sent only to api.anthropic.com, with your API key. No other server is contacted.
options_privacySent: Only what you choose to send to Claude leaves your device: your question, and the text of pages or excerpts you attach.
options_privacyStored: The key, settings, library and conversations stay on this device. The extension sends no statistics or logs.
options_privacyTiming: Sending happens only when you explicitly ask for it, never in the background.
options_shortcutsChange: To change a shortcut, open the browser's add-ons page, then "Manage Extension Shortcuts".
options_sidebarReadsActiveTab: The panel can read the active tab
